end.summary:
Practised keeping the school clean, green and safe as a shared responsibility.
Reviewed putting waste in the correct bin and using wet waste to make compost.
Discussed using compost in the garden and turning the compost.
Identified plastic wrappers as unsuitable for compost and possible safety hazards when left on the floor.
Teach-back was not passed; no unaided correct attempt was recorded.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting waste, explaining how wet waste becomes compost for plants, and discussing why plastic wrappers do not belong in compost. They also gave reasons for everyone helping with cleaning, including preventing slips and keeping water areas clean. At home, ask Anika to sort a few everyday items into wet waste, dry waste, or neither, and explain each choice.
